rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something combining or offering a range of different styles, ideas, or types.

example.english: This restaurant has a very eclectic menu, with both Chinese and Western dishes.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳個餐牌好多元化，中西菜式都有。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 go3 caan1 paai2 hou2 do1 jyun4 faa3 zung1 sai1 coi3 sik1 dou1 jau5

rows.note: Use this in formal or written contexts when the subject deliberately embraces the best elements of different doctrines, methods, or styles.

example.english: This curriculum is eclectic, embracing the essence of both Chinese and Western medicine.
example.traditional: 呢套課程兼收並蓄中西醫學嘅精髓。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 fo3 cing4 gim1 sau1 bing6 cuk1 zung1 sai1 ji1 hok6 ge3 zing1 seoi5

rows.note: Use this for a casual, often slightly negative description of unrelated or miscellaneous things rather than a deliberately well-chosen mix.

example.english: My drawer is full of eclectic odds and ends, so it is hard to find a pen.
example.traditional: 我個抽屜入面放住啲雜七雜八嘅嘢，搵支筆都難。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 cau1 tai3 jap6 min6 fong3 zyu6 di1 zaap6 cat1 zaap6 baat3 ge3 je5 wan2 zi1 bat1 dou1 naan4
